# customer-journey-locations-mockup.png

**Type:** UI wireframe/mockup, screen 7 of the customer journey flow.
**Source context:** `## Customer Journey screen flow`, step 7, picking
existing On-Net locations and adding Off-Net (3rd-party) locations.

Left nav tree: `Configuration` > `SASE` > `Base Subscription`,
`Locations` (expanded) > `List of Locations` (selected), `Group Access
Sites`, `Individual Access Sites` (both greyed/not yet reached),
`Add-ons Subscription`. Right panel "Existing On-Net Locations" table
with Include checkboxes, Name/Region/Street/City/ZIP columns: `HQ`,
`AT1`, `AT2` (Attica), `CM1`, `CM2` (Central Macedonia, checked), `CM3`
(Central Macedonia, unchecked), `CR1` (Crete), `CG1` (Central Greece) —
all checked except CM3. Below, "Off-Net Locations" table listing `CG2`
(Central Greece, 32 Gazepi, Chalkida, 34100) with a `Remove` action, plus
an empty input row to add a new one, and a note that "by providing 3rd
party managed connectivity you confirm its performance is sufficient".
`OK` (highlighted/clicked) and `Cancel` buttons.
